anchor.quote: Nora makes tea. The kettle boils. She sits down. Biscuit sleeps in his basket.

suggestions.reason: Tea and kettle are a slow start; opening on the knock puts the conflict in the first second.

anchor.quote: Nora reads the newspaper for a while.

suggestions.reason: Waiting with no story; viewers scroll away here.

suggestions.text: Biscuit's head pops up from his basket, ears straight up, eyes locked on the open door.
suggestions.reason: Shows what Biscuit wants before Nora says stay, so the dash reads with the sound off.

anchor.quote: Biscuit runs out the open door anyway.

suggestions.text: Nora lunges for the door, hand flying to her mouth as a small white tail vanishes down the street.
suggestions.reason: The turn needs a big, held face to land.

anchor.quote: Nora is worried because Biscuit is missing.

suggestions.reason: Explains the feeling; her reaction and the empty porch at night already show it.

anchor.quote: A muddy Biscuit trots up the steps carrying Nora's lost glasses.

suggestions.text: Nora drops the lead, kneels in the rain, and her face crumples into a laugh as he sets the glasses in her palm.
suggestions.reason: This is the payoff of loyalty, so hold on her face before the line.

suggestions.text: ★ Iron Paws screen: Iron Paws bag (front) — on the kitchen counter as Nora, glasses on, scoops it into Biscuit's bowl
suggestions.reason: The script never shows the product; a reward feeding at the payoff brings the real bag in naturally.
